description: The Studio Context Edit: why the wanted instruction did not produce the good turn, and the wording change that would.

cause.description: missing: the wanted state is new. gated: the item exists behind a predicate that did not fire. overpowered: the item that won outweighed it. ambiguous: the item is present and does not decide the turn, the tangential case included. tool: a tool description or its placement drove the call. indicator: a progress indicator steered the turn. code: the cause is in agent code.

saw.description: What the model saw at the failure turn.

section.description: The prompt section the wanted item rendered in, or null when absent.

items.description: One more item the card must show, from the scenario or the general context, when the cause sits there.

file.description: The block file as the outline's `# <file>` header prints it (`blocks/….json`).

pointer.description: JSON pointer as the outline prints it.

role.description: A for the wanted side, B for the winning side.

also.description: Empty in the common case: the card's Studio Context is built from the analysis.

tool.description: A tool description that took part.

name.description: The tool name, or null when no tool took part.

text.description: The description sentence that took part, verbatim.

edits.description: The wording changes that together make the good turn follow: instructions that change the task definition, not the symptom. One entry per changed text, in the order they read.

kind.description: item: a block item's text. gate: a condition's predicate text. tool: a tool description in agent code, not applied.

file.description: item, gate: the block file as the outline's `# <file>` header prints it (`blocks/….json`). tool: path.ts:line of the description.

pointer.description: item, gate: JSON pointer of the text edited; null for a new item. tool: null.

path.description: Display-name path; for a tool, its name.

old.description: The text as it is, or null for a new item.

new.description: The text as it becomes, or null for a removal.

after.description: Pointer of the item the new one follows, when old is null.

scope.description: pattern when the instruction covers a class of situations, situation when it covers one.

ripple.description: What the change gives force to or makes redundant, one sentence, or null.

items.description: A competing edit with a larger ripple.

new.description: The text as it would become.

tree_moved.description: The item reads differently in the tree than in the request the call saw; give both readings, the edit targets the tree.

code.description: The change is in agent code beyond a tool description; name the file and the string.

sync.description: .composer carries an unfinished pull or conflict markers; say what blocks.py reported.

missing.description: Files you needed and did not find; empty when none.

push.description: An edit did not land in the workspace: lint failed, or the diff after the second pull is not empty; what it reported.

feedback.description: How you weighed the feedback this run carries, as feedback.md says; null when it carries none.

verdict.description: accepted: every point; partly: some; disputed: none.

basis.description: For a dispute, the skill passage or the evidence (a turn, a block item, a run) that decides it, quoted; null for an accepted point.
